law.citation: The Southern Nations, Nationalities and Peoples' Region was divided by referendum under Article 47 of the Constitution of Ethiopia: Sidama became a region in June 2020, South West Ethiopia Peoples' Region in November 2021, and South Ethiopia and Central Ethiopia in August 2023, when the former region ceased.

units.citation: Wikidata, this region's item: English label and item id, and its ISO 3166-2 code (P300) where ISO has assigned one. The GeoNames id is the region's row in GeoNames admin1CodesASCII.txt.

membership.citation: Each member is assigned to the region that GeoNames files most of the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-26. Every zone has at least 85% of those places in one region.
